content: {"episode_id":"ep-05045","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication documents a patient with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42), a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9), and known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5). As stated in the ordering note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring. Per SilverBridge Advantage's letter inviting appeal with supporting clinical documentation, this indication establishes the medical necessity of the service and we request reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 722.52."}
